data.one_liner: An overlay tooltip handler for app onboarding sequences.
data.what_it_does: Helps display customizable tooltips over specific widgets for app onboarding. Provides a TooltipController to manage starting, dismissing, pausing, and navigating between tooltips.
use_when: You need to guide users through app features with onboarding tooltips.
You want custom layouts and colors for your tooltip widgets and overlays.
avoid_when: You need standard Material tooltips triggered by long presses or hovers.
strengths: Gives control over overlay colors and tooltip custom widgets.
Supports sequential navigation with next, previous, and index control.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced edge cases beyond the basic scaffold setup.
